title: Cookie and Similar Technologies Policy
summary: This policy explains the cookies and browser storage technologies used in Art of Menu's business panel, sales partner portal, waiter portal and guest menu. Art of Menu uses only cookies that are strictly necessary for the service to work and functional browser storage. No analytics, advertising or marketing cookies are used.

blocks.p: Art of Menu is operated by Göktigin Bilişim Teknoloji Ltd. Şti. (the Company). The Company's details are set out on the [Company and Legal Information](doc:company) page. If you have any questions, you can write to [hello@goktigin.com](mailto:hello@goktigin.com).

sections.heading: 2. What Are Cookies and Browser Storage?

blocks.p: A cookie is a small text file that a website saves in your browser and that is sent back to the site with subsequent requests. Local storage (localStorage) and session storage (sessionStorage) are similar technologies that allow a site to keep information in your browser; this information is not sent to the server automatically. Information in session storage is deleted when the tab is closed.

ul: Only technologies that are necessary or functional for providing the service you request, such as logging in, security and remembering your preferences, are used.
No analytics, advertising, marketing or social media cookies are used. There are no tracking pixels and no third-party tracking code.
The guest menu uses no cookies at all. Menu usage statistics are collected without cookies.
For this reason, no cookie consent banner is shown. Because the technologies used are necessary for the service to work, the related features will not work if they are disabled.

blocks.p: All of the cookies below are first-party, strictly necessary session cookies. They are sent only over secure connections (HTTPS) and cannot be read by scripts in the browser (HttpOnly). Each cookie contains only a random session key; only a hash of this key is stored on the server.

blocks.p: The map shown in the location picker in the business panel is loaded from OpenStreetMap servers (openstreetmap.org). When the map is displayed, your browser connects to these servers and OpenStreetMap processes your IP address and browser information under its own policy. Art of Menu does not place any cookies through this connection.

Other services that the panel connects to directly from your browser (for example automatic translation, address search, weather and exchange rates) are described in the [KVKK Privacy Notice for Business Users](doc:privacy-business#recipients). The guest menu does not load any third-party content.

You can delete or block cookies and browser storage using the option to clear site data in your browser settings. If session cookies are deleted, you will be logged out and will need to log in again. If cookies are blocked, the panel, the partner portal and the waiter portal will not work. The guest menu works without cookies; if browser storage is blocked, joining a table may not be remembered when the tab is refreshed.

If the Company decides in future to use a cookie or similar technology that is not strictly necessary (for example for analytics or marketing), it will update this policy before starting to use it and obtain your consent where required. Such technologies will not run without your consent, and you can withdraw your consent at any time.
